source.name: Problem Statement: Verifiable Human Mandates for Autonomous Agent Actions
source.status: active individual Internet-Draft; problem statement only; no protocol defined

requirements.name: Action-to-mandate binding
requirements.gap: AuditSpec consumes an external binding-verification result but does not define the cryptographic binding construction, canonicalization, signing format, or verifier.

requirements.name: Deterministic server-side verifiability
requirements.gap: The evaluator is deterministic over explicit mandate/action data, but cryptographic mandate and binding verification remain external inputs.

requirements.name: Independently verifiable evidence output
requirements.gap: AuditSpec now emits an independently verifiable Ed25519 proof over RFC 8785 content bindings and the deterministic evaluation. Independent replay of the original human mandate signature and T0-to-T1 binding cryptography still depends on the external mandate protocol that produced those verifier outcomes.

requirements.name: Transport and format neutrality
requirements.gap: The evaluator is transport-neutral after projection into its semantic model, but AuditSpec does not yet define format-neutral canonical binding from arbitrary wire payloads into action parameters.

requirements.name: Escalation without re-centralizing every action
requirements.gap: AuditSpec can signal that autonomous authority ended, but does not define the fresh human-authorization interaction or resulting replacement mandate.
